Name: Fantastic Phoenixes
Author: nugmods
Description:
My original sprites for Mizu's Phoenixes! Inspired by, and intended to be paired with, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Farm Animal Facelift[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/kwillow/mods]Kwillow's Animals.[/url] Also, I have something like 1200 hours combined in both versions of Ark Survival, so it's very much inspired by the Ark version of the Phoenix and the original creature it was based off of, the Argentavis. ncludes all color variants from the original mod, plus: an Alternative Textures pack of Pride flag themed recolors! Happy Pride, y'all!

[b]Q. Why is it so fucking big?
[/b]
Have [i]you[/i] ever seen a Phoenix in real life? You tell me how big it should be.

[b]Install:[/b]
Just put it in your mods folder, I promise it's that easy 

Credits:
Mizu, for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46295]Mizu's Phoenix[/url]
Kwillow, for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/kwillow/mods]K's Animals[/url], which inspired my art 
Siamece, for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9057]Farm Animal Facelift[/url], which also inspired my art
